Some weapons you'll come across have special properties that set them apart from others of their class, such as superior durability or above-average attack power.|Tips and Tricks|TotK}} also known as {{Term/Store|Seal|Seals|AoC|plural}},{{Exp Game|AoC}}{{Cite|Remove Seals|N/A|AoC}} are a recurring mechanic in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Overview== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Weapon Bonuses are advantageous modifiers randomly given to [[Item]]s in [[Link]]'s [[Inventory]] when they are first obtained. Despite their name, Weapon Bonuses are not exclusive to [[Weapon]]s and can also be found on [[Shield]]s and [[Bow]]s. ====Modifier types==== There are several different types of modifiers granted by Weapon Bonuses, and they come in two "tiers" indicated by their color: white and yellow. Although some Weapons are set to have a minimum tier of Weapon Bonus, most are determined by the [[World Level]]– a given weapon starts out with no modifiers, then is guaranteed a white one, then a yellow one. This renders The following is a list of Weapon Bonuses per tier with their effects. Some Weapon Bonuses are only applicable to certain types of Weapons; there are also more specific restrictions expanded upon in the next section. {{Data Table |game= BotW |sortable= false |columns= Weapon Bonus (white tier), Modifier Effect, Weapon Bonus (yellow tier), Modifier Effect, Applicable Weapon Type |- | [[File:BotW Attack Up Icon.png|25px]] Attack Up | Increases attack power by random integer within some range [x, y], varies per weapon | [[File:BotW Attack Up+ Icon.png|25px]] Attack Up+ | Increases attack power by random integer within some range [y+1, z], varies per weapon | Weapons, Bows |- | [[File:BotW Durability Up Icon.png|25px]] Durability Up | Increases durability by random integer within some range [x, y], varies per weapon | [[File:BotW Durability Up+ Icon.png|25px]] Durability Up+ | Increases durability by random integer within some range [y+1, z], varies per weapon | Weapons, Bows, Shields |- | [[File:BotW Shield Guard Up Icon.png|25px]] Shield Guard Up | Increases Shield Guard by random integer within some range [x, y], varies per shield | [[File:BotW Shield Guard Up+ Icon.png|25px]] Shield Guard Up+ | Increases Shield Guard by random integer within some range [y+1, z], varies per shield | Shields |- | [[File:BotW Critical Hit Icon.png|25px]] Critical Hit | Last hit of a chain does double damage/staggers enemies | [[File:BotW Long Throw Icon.png|25px]] Long Throw | Throw distance multiplied by a random float between [1.5, 2.0] | Weapons |- | N/A | N/A | [[File:BotW Quick Shot Icon.png|25px]] Quick Shot | Bow draw distance multiplied by a random float between [1.1, 1.3] | Bows |- | N/A | N/A | [[File:BotW Five-Shot Burst Icon.png|25px]] Five-Shot Burst | Bow shoots five arrows instead of three | Bows |- }} Weapons obtained through [[amiibo]] are guaranteed the maximum value for their applicable modifier tier (white or yellow), but will display as white regardless of which one it actually received. Additionally, due to a bug, Shields dropped from amiibo chests which are meant to have the white Shield Guard Up bonus will apply that value to the durability and correctly display it as a Durability Up bonus. This means that Shields from amiibo cannot receive Shield Guard Up, and have two possible values for Durability Up. This does ''not'' apply to the second-tier Shield Guard Up+ bonus, though as mentioned this will display as white bonus. There are also two unused types of Weapon Bonus within the game, both of which would be yellow: Shield Surf Up, which multiplies the friction of a Shield when [[Shield Surfing]] by 0.2, and an unnamed bonus for Bows internally called AddZoomRapid, which gives any bow a zoom property similar to the [[Golden Bow]] or [[Phrenic Bow]]. ====Modifier chances==== The particular Weapon Bonus received by a certain item is random within its tier. However, they may be seen with gameplay modification or glitches. * Some Items never receive any Weapon Bonuses: ** Unique Equipment:
{{Icon List|BotW|Master Sword, Bow of Light, One-Hit Obliterator, Lightscale Trident, Ceremonial Trident, Scimitar of the Seven, Daybreaker, Boulder Breaker, Great Eagle Bow}} ** Weapons from Shops:
{{Icon List|BotW|Ancient Short Sword, Ancient Bladesaw, Ancient Spear, Ancient Shield, Ancient Bow, Spring-Loaded Hammer}} ** Skeleton Arms:
{{Icon List|BotW|Bokoblin Arm, Moblin Arm, Lizalfos Arm}} ** Special case:
{{Icon List|BotW|Farmer's Pitchfork}} * Some Items only are seen with white Weapon Bonuses, and never yellow ones: **{{Icon List|BotW|Tree Branch, Soup Ladle, Boat Oar, Woodcutter's Axe, Wooden Mop, Pot Lid, Wooden Bow}} After the [[World Level]] has reached a high enough point, white Weapon Bonuses (most notably the Critical Hit effect) effectively go "extinct", becoming [[Permanently Missable Items#Breath of the Wild|Permanently Missable Items]]. The [[Hero's Shield]] can also never receive Shield Guard Up due to the bug explained above which affects amiibo drops, and it is amiibo-exclusive. There are also some Items which may have only one or a few instances where they may have a Weapon Bonus, such as the [[Torch]] in a [[Treasure Chest]] inside [[Divine Beast Vah Rudania]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== The Weapon Bonus system in {{TotK}} is mostly the same as in {{BotW}}. However, instead of ranges that vary per Equipment, the random value for Attack Up and Durability Up bonuses is within set ranges for any Equipment. In addition to Weapon Bonuses, certain Weapons now have [[Weapon Trait]]s, which grant Weapons within a certain series unique abilities. If [[Rock Octorok]] sucks up a Weapon, Shield, or Bow when inhaling, it will spit it out with a new Weapon Bonus as well as replenishing its [[Durability]]. Rare or unique equipment cannot receive Weapon Bonuses under normal circumstances, except for the [[Hylian Shield]], which can receive Weapon Bonuses from scaling, Rock Octoroks, and when purchased from [[Cece]]. The pieces of Equipment that cannot normally receive a Weapon Bonus include: {{Icon List|TotK|Biggoron's Sword, Boulder Breaker, Daybreaker, Demon King's Bow, Dusk Bow, Dusk Claymore, Fierce Deity
